description: This file defines classes and methods for configuring OSTree setup commands in a kickstart installation process, including parsing arguments and generating command strings.

classes.name: F21_OSTreeSetup
classes.description: Class for OSTree setup configuration specific to Fedora 21, extending KickstartCommand.

classes.name: RHEL7_OSTreeSetup
classes.description: Subclass for RHEL 7 OSTree setup, inherits from F21_OSTreeSetup.

classes.name: RHEL8_OSTreeSetup
classes.description: Subclass for RHEL 8 OSTree setup, inherits from F21_OSTreeSetup.

classes.name: RHEL9_OSTreeSetup
classes.description: Subclass for RHEL 9 OSTree setup, inherits from F21_OSTreeSetup.

classes.name: F38_OSTreeSetup
classes.description: Subclass for Fedora 38 OSTree setup, inherits from F21_OSTreeSetup, with additional conflicting commands.

classes.name: F43_OSTreeSetup
classes.description: Subclass for Fedora 43 OSTree setup, inherits from F38_OSTreeSetup, with additional conflicting commands.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the OSTree setup command with parameters like osname, remote, url, ref, and nogpg.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the command, including OSTree setup details if seen.

methods.name: _getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Generates command-line argument string based on current object attributes.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser for OSTree setup options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, sets object attributes, and validates URL protocol.
